name: Arca Life Sciences
description: Official hosted server from Arca. Free, no-key, read-only search of public life-sciences records: ranked PubMed literature with OpenAlex citation counts and open-access filters, FDA drug and device records (labels, approvals, warning letters, Form 483s, 510(k)/PMA, MAUDE), ClinicalTrials.gov, VAERS, CDC data and EU/PMDA device vigilance. Every result cites its source URL.
author: Arca
